summary: The display name 'Game GOAT' and the catalog description are set explicitly in .printing-press.json (display_name, catalog_display_name, catalog_description) and mirrored on every other user-facing surface.
reason: The generator derived the product label from the API spec title instead of the intended brand, so the CLI help, MCP server name, auth help, README hero, and the library listing all advertised the wrong name. A previous rename attempt stopped halfway and left a stale .printing-press.json.pre-name-fix behind (deleted here). A regen must keep the explicit values rather than re-deriving a label from the spec title.
validated_outcome: A case-insensitive grep for the previous spec-derived label over the CLI directory returns zero hits, and 'Game GOAT' is present on every surface listed in files[].
